newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian stocks end mixed in sluggish trade.
newsitem.headline: Colombian stocks end mixed in sluggish trade.

text.p: Colombian stocks ended mixed in sluggish markets Thursday that saw Banco de Colombia recovering some of its earlier losses.
Bogota's IBB index ended 0.14 percent higher at 874.68 on a thin 497 million peso volume. Medellin's IBOMED index dipped 0.22 percent to 13,522.42 on a 548.6 million peso volume.

"Trading was very thin Thursday because month-end accounts had to be drawn up. We see the same trend at this point every month but this was coupled with a speculative tendency," one Bogota broker said.

The main movers on the Bogota exchange were Banco de Colombia, up 0.45 percent to 440 on volume of 139 million pesos and insurance company Compania Suramericana de Seguros, down 0.05 percent to 18,500 on volume of 97.7 million pesos.

"Speculation in Banco de Colombia continued. Many investors moved to snap up shares in view of last week's price fall. They buy low and try to sell high in a very short period," another Bogota broker said.
Banco Ganadero ordinary shares climbed 0.74 percent to 272 on volume of 42.4 million pesos, while Banco Industrial Colombiano rose 0.43 percent to 3,500 on volume of 50 million pesos.

"Some deals were done on the basis of third-quarter results but on the whole I don't think investors are really reorganizing portfolios until all the third-quarter results are out," another broker added.
The main movers in Medellin were brewing giant Bavaria, down 1.41 percent to 4,042 on volume of 4.2 million pesos and Banco de Bogota, down 1.63 percent to 6,000.

"There was some profit-taking but the volumes weren't very significant. There's still a lot of apathy on the Medellin exchange partly because high hopes on third quarter results didn't materialize," a Medellin broker said.
